purpose: Describe the intended product target separately from source control, runner, and deployment mechanics so Bootstrap can recommend a low-setup prototype or limited working product without making a production claim.
adapter_rule: adapter_id is a typed project-context selector. It is not a credential, account, endpoint, or permission to contact a provider.
cross_contract_rule: The selected target mode, audience, and data posture cannot exceed the Project Life Contract. A target may be less ambitious than the life contract, but a route-changing expansion requires a new owner-bound life contract.

managed_site_option.rule: This option may be selected for a prototype or explicitly limited working product. It never implies standard production, public availability, durable-data support, authentication support, quota, cost, or rollback capability without project-bound evidence.

safety_rules: PROTOTYPE targets are synthetic or explicitly admitted and carry no production claim.
LIMITED_PRODUCT targets require an explicit supported scope, audience, data posture, operating envelope, and rollback path.
STANDARD_PRODUCTION requires a matching production project life contract and exact acceptance, deployment, and rollback identity.
Provider capabilities are never invented from an adapter name; unproven capabilities remain unproven.

binding.context: typed Project Context carries the complete target and its digest
